data.name: Usage
data.value:
UsbForensicAudit.Cli — headless USB artifact scanning.
Usage: UsbForensicAudit.Cli.exe [options]
Options: --json <file> save the full scan result as JSON (with --diff saves the comparison report) --reports <dir> generate reports into the given directory --formats <list> comma-separated report formats (default: html,pdf) allowed: html, pdf, brief-pdf, analyst-pdf, excel, brief-excel, analyst-excel --list-sessions list saved sessions and exit (no scanning) --diff <base> <tgt> compare two saved sessions: what appeared and what disappeared between scans --offline <root> offline analysis of another system: a mounted disk image (e.g. F:\) or a copied Windows folder; only registry hives are analyzed, examined files are never modified --fleet <dir> fleet summary: read scan JSON exports from several machines and show removable media seen on more than one computer (with --json saves the summary to a file) --verify verify evidence base integrity: recompute the journal hash-chain and check session seals against the database (with --json saves the verification report) --lang <ru|en> message language (default: system language) --quiet, -q do not print step-by-step progress --help, -h show this help
Exit codes: 0 scan completed successfully 1 execution error 2 administrator privileges missing 3 cancelled by the user (Ctrl+C) 4 verification found integrity violations 64 invalid arguments
The result is always saved to the data\audit.sqlite database next to the executable — the same one used by the GUI application.
